package.name: mecanumbot_custom_nav2
package.description:
Map analysis for Mecanumbot's seeking system. This package decides things about maps and commands no motion: the RRT frontier detector over slam_toolbox's occupancy grid, the occupancy model itself, the T1 exit criteria (which include the Deep3R server's verdict on the reconstruction), and the agreement handler, which runs in both phases and turns that verdict into a nav2 keepout mask, a revisit list and markers, so the point cloud's knowledge of what the lidar plane cannot see reaches the navigation stack.
The pass that acts on all of this is mecanumbot_autoslam, in the mecanumbot_behaviours repository: sending the robot to a frontier is a behaviour, and it moved there with the launch files that start it. The nav2 tuning is not here either: it is a parameter file in mecanumbot_description, because it needed no code.
